text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"12 forks"},{"id":"q2","value":16,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"16 knives"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"subtract forks from knives (16-12) as the first step of the Euclidean algorithm"},{"op":"div","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"divide forks (12) by that difference (4) to check how many times it fits evenly"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","s1"],"out":"s3","note":"multiply the quotient back by the difference"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"subtract to confirm the remainder is zero, confirming the greatest common factor -- the greatest number of silverware holders Shelley can stock"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"greatest number of silverware holders Shelley can stock"},"dismissed":[]}
